svg.text: Buzzer and beacon drivers, and the serial link that carries all sensor data to the camera board.
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
D3 high → Q1 on → buzzer sounds (~30 mA).
D1 absorbs the coil's turn-off spike.
D13 high → Q2 on → LED lit from +5V.
Use 150 Ω for a red LED.
Flashes 8 times a second during a survivor alert.
LINK_TX_5V = Uno D1 (5 V) → R1/R2 → 3.3 V at IO13.
LINK_RX = IO14 (3.3 V) → Uno D0 directly.
115200 baud: status every 0.4 s, commands back.
Leave the micro-SD slot empty (IO13/14 are SD pins).
C6 stops resets when the flash LED (IO4) turns on.
Module header pin order (as printed on the boards)
VCC · OUT · GND (check under the dome)
VCC · DATA · GND (bare: VCC DATA nc GND)
brown GND · red V+ · orange SIG
ENA · IN1 · IN2 · IN3 · IN4 · ENB
5V · GND · IO12 · IO13 · IO15 · IO14 · IO2 · IO4
3V3 · IO16 · IO0 · GND · VCC · U0R · U0T · GND
2 anode pins (+), 2 cathode pins (−, notched corner)
flat face toward you: C · B · E
